# Typography

Font loading and font-family tokens.

## What's here

- `imports.css`: `@font-face` rules and font imports
- `fontFamilies.css`: `--font-*` tokens, generated from Figma

## Good to know

`main.css` loads `imports.css` before Tailwind so the font utilities point at fonts that exist. Edits to `fontFamilies.css` are overwritten by the next [Figma sync](../../figma/README.figma.md), so port changes into the generator first.

## How it connects

- Font files live in [assets/fonts](../../assets/fonts/README.fonts.md).
- Imported by [main.css](../main.css).
